question: For the state ethics bodies the game already routes complaints to, how long does each step take in practice or by rule — intake, notice to the respondent, the respondent's answer, investigation, and a finding?

sourcesChecked.whatItDidNotSettle: Durations are authored with no source.

title: How long each step of a state ethics complaint actually takes
usableAnswer: Per state body, statutory or rule deadlines where they exist, and typical durations where they do not; say which are legal deadlines and which are observed practice.
whyItMatters: PR #428 (merged 2026-09-22) gave ethics findings consequences. src/simulation/press/procedures.ts:418, :430, :441, :454 apply one invented calendar of 14/21/45/60 days to all 24 researched state ethics bodies (basis: 'authored' in the data, no question id), and src/simulation/press/claim-route.ts:19-29 adds a 30-day fallback and a 140/126/105/60 remaining-days table. The routes themselves are sourced; only the timing is made up. ethics-procedure-unread-detail-wy-id-ut covers three states whose procedures could not be read, not the durations.
